problem_statement:
Show Name of Message element
__Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.__

Currently, names of message elements on message flows are not rendered

Given [this example diagram](https://github.com/bpmn-io/bpmn-js/files/1860134/Delivery.zip)


![](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3998764/38089798-4f00974c-3369-11e8-8f66-6c733a5354d9.png)

__Describe the solution you'd like__

Render the name of the message elements below. Consider that message flows can have labels itself.

__Describe alternatives you've considered__

Start working on #447 beforehand to create a better handling between message names and message flow labels.
